==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|requeste||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|request}}, from {{der|en|fro|requeste}} ({{cog|fr|requête}}), from {{der|en|la-vul|*requaesita}}, from {{der|en|la|requīsīta}}, feminine of {{m|la|requīsītus||requested, demanded}}, past participle of {{m|la|requīrō||require, ask}}, composed of {{m|la|re-}} + {{m|la|quaerō||to seek, look for}}, of uncertain origin, but possibly from {{der|en|itc-pro|*kʷaizeō}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*kʷeh₂-||to acquire}}. Compare to {{cog|fr|requérir}}.<!-- From Online Etymology Dictionary and Century 1911. -->

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈkwɛst/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-request.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛst|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|re|quest}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|or|with a subjunctive clause}} To ask for (something).
#: {{syn|en|bespeak|formal}}
#: {{ux|en|The corporal '''requested''' reinforcements.}}
#: {{ux|en|I have '''requested''' that the furniture be moved back to its original position.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To ask (somebody) to do something.
#: {{syn|en|ask|bespeak|call for}}
#: {{ux|en|She called me into her office and '''requested''' me to sit down.}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# Act of [[requesting]] (with the [[adposition]] ''at'' in the presence of [[possessive]]s, and ''on'' in their absence).
#: {{syn|en|asking|beseech|prayer|wish}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Merry Wives|I|i|passage=I will marry her, sir, at your '''request'''.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1839|journal=The Law Journal for the Year 1832-1949: Comprising Reports
|passage=The promise that arises upon an account stated, is to pay on '''request'''.}}
# A formal [[message]] requesting something.
#: {{syn|en|petition|postulation}}
# [[condition|Condition]] of being sought after.
#: {{syn|en|demand}}
#* {{RQ:Temple Miscellanea|part=2|page=49|passage=I do not doubt, but many Great and more Noble Uſes would have been made of ſuch Conqueſts or Diſcoveries, if they had fallen to the ſhare of the ''Greeks'' and ''Romans'' in thoſe Ages, when Knowledge and Fame were in as great '''Requeſt''', as endleſs Gains and Wealth are among us now; [...]}}
# {{lb|en|networking}} A [[message]] sent over a [[network]] to a [[server]].
#: {{ux|en|The server returned a 404 error to the HTTP '''request'''.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} That which is asked for or requested.
#* {{RQ:King James Version|Psalms|106|15|passage=He gave them their '''request'''.}}
